DM bottleneck

Every lead starts in your inbox

"DM me MATRIX" works, but it means the front door runs through DMs. Each keyword has to be answered, tagged and followed up, by you or a team member.

Books sell elsewhere

Readers don't land on your list

Your books sell through retailers, so the buyer belongs to the store. Nothing turns a reader into an email subscriber who has already bought from you directly.

Content treadmill

5,936 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post and the next episode. When you rest, which is the very thing you teach, the lead flow rests too.

The high performers who love your work but aren't ready for the big decision today have nowhere to say a small yes, so most of them say nothing.

My recommendation

A free masterclass built on your Matrix, with a toolkit straight after sign-up

You already have the audience, the books and a lead magnet people ask for. What's missing is one evergreen 60-minute class that walks people through how you make a big money decision from calm instead of stress, offers a low-ticket toolkit on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply on the replay. Meta ads put that class in front of new high performers every day, and the toolkit sales help fund the ads.

Fixes the DM bottleneck

The Matrix becomes the class handout. One link in your bio and in every ad does the work your DMs do now, and every sign-up is an email you own.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites people who want your direct guidance to apply. You only talk to people who watched, stayed and told you what decision they're facing.

Pays for the ads

The toolkit brings revenue in on day one, so a share of the ad spend is covered by the front end while your high-ticket clients are the profit.

The 95%*

Not ready for the big decision yet

They watch the class, take the toolkit, and keep learning from your emails and Plenty. They pay you a small amount while they build trust, and many come back for your program later.

The qualified 5%

Ready to upgrade with you

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up for the conversation.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The fourth spreadsheet"

Hook
"If you've built the spreadsheet four times and still can't decide, the spreadsheet isn't the problem." (to camera, on the sofa, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"High performers are brilliant at analysis. But when a decision feels big, stress quietly takes over and the analysis just loops. What helps is checking in with your body first, then using a simple framework to decide and act." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach exactly how in a free 60-minute class called The Big Money Decision. Tap Sign up. Educational content, not financial advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you decide"

Hook
"Before you say yes or no to your next big money decision, ask these three questions." (Kate holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: what does my body do when I picture saying yes? Two: am I deciding from fear of missing out, or from what I actually want? Three: what's the smallest step that would tell me more?" (caption for each question)
CTA
"I walk through the whole Big Money Decision Matrix in my free class. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me where to start: the podcast, the books, or working with me. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, come to my free class first. You'll see how I think about money, try the Matrix on a real decision, and know whether going deeper with me is right for you."
CTA
"It's called The Big Money Decision, it's free, and there's a replay. Tap Sign up."
